title: The Facts
question: What was the consequence of the editor's insistence on facts and statistics?

meanings.usage: 指报刊、杂志、书籍等内容的审核、整理人员
指从事新闻采访、报道工作的人员
正式用法，指上级给下级明确指示做某事，常用结构instruct sb to do sth
可指书籍、报刊、文章等的正式发布
前缀im-表否定，对应反义词patient，常用搭配be impatient with sb/at sth
用来修饰动作，表示做某事时很不情愿
用来描述事物最开始的状态
常用被动语态be arrested表示“被逮捕”
常指某个行为或事件带来的直接结果，常用搭配as a consequence
通常以复数形式出现，指具体的统计数字

phrases.usage: 表示“走极端；做过头”，描述人在做某事时过于偏激，超出合理范围

examples.en: Some parents go to extremes to send their children to the best schools.
examples.zh: 有些家长为了把孩子送到最好的学校做得太过极端。

phrases.usage: 表示“着手做某事；开始努力做某事”，强调带着明确目标开始行动

examples.en: He set out to finish the report within three days.
examples.zh: 他着手准备在三天内完成这份报告。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，表示“（报刊、杂志）付印；即将出版”

examples.en: The weekly magazine will go to press tomorrow, so we have to submit the article today.
examples.zh: 这本周刊明天就要付印了，所以我们今天必须提交文章。

phrases.usage: 表示“不仅……而且……”，用于连接两个并列的成分，强调后者

examples.en: Not only did she win the first prize, but she got a scholarship as well.
examples.zh: 她不仅获得了一等奖，还拿到了奖学金。

phrases.usage: 此处表示“通向；通往”，此外也可表示“导致；引起”某个结果

examples.en: This path leads to the small village at the foot of the mountain.
examples.zh: 这条小路通向山脚下的小村庄。

examples.en: Lack of exercise can lead to many health problems.
examples.zh: 缺乏锻炼会导致很多健康问题。

sentences.en: Editors of newspapers and magazines often go to extremes to provide their readers with unimportant facts and statistics.
sentences.zh: 报纸杂志的编辑们常常不厌其烦地向读者提供一些无关紧要的事实和统计数字。

sentences.en: Last year a journalist had been instructed by a well-known magazine to write an article on the president's palace in a new African republic.
sentences.zh: 去年，一家有名的杂志派一名记者去撰写一篇有关一个非洲新共和国总统府的稿件。

sentences.en: When the article arrived, the editor read the first sentence and then refused to publish it.
sentences.zh: 稿件寄来后，编辑看了第一句话就拒绝发表。

sentences.en: The article began:'Hundreds of steps lead to the high wall which surrounds the president's palace.'
sentences.zh: 文章的开头是这样的：“几百级台阶通向总统府四周的高墙。”

sentences.en: The editor at once sent the journalist a fax instructing him to find out the exact number of steps and the height of the wall.
sentences.zh: 编辑立即给记者发了一份传真，指示他查明台阶的确切数字和围墙的高度。

sentences.en: The journalist immediately set out to obtain these important facts, but he took a long time to send them.
sentences.zh: 记者立即动身去搜集这些重要的事实，但过了很久才把材料寄来。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the editor was getting impatient, for the magazine would soon go to press.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，编辑等得不耐烦了，因为杂志很快就要付印。

sentences.en: He sent the journalist two more faxes, but received no reply.
sentences.zh: 他又给记者发了两份传真，但没有任何回音。

sentences.en: He sent yet another fax informing the journalist that if he did not reply soon he would be fired.
sentences.zh: 他又发了一份传真，通知记者说如果再不迅速回复，他就将被解雇。

sentences.en: When the journalist again failed to reply, the editor reluctantly published the article as it had originally been written.
sentences.zh: 记者还是没有回复，编辑只好不情愿地按原样发表了那篇文章。

sentences.en: A week later, the editor at last received a fax from the journalist.
sentences.zh: 一周后，编辑终于接到了记者的一份传真。

sentences.en: Not only had the poor man been arrested, but he had been sent to prison as well.
sentences.zh: 那可怜的记者不仅被捕了，而且还被送进了监狱。

sentences.en: However, he had at last been allowed to send a fax in which he informed the editor that he had been arrested
sentences.zh: 然而，他最终获准发了一份传真，在传真中他告诉编辑，他被捕了，

sentences.en: while counting the 1,084 steps leading to the 15th foot wall which surrounded the president's palace.
sentences.zh: 因为他正在数通向总统府的1084级台阶和围绕总统府15英尺高的围墙。

grammar.title: 过去完成时的被动语态
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个动作之前已经完成的被动动作，即“过去的过去”发生的被动行为
grammar.structure: had been + 动词过去分词
grammar.usage: 当句子中动作的承受者作为主语，且动作发生在过去另一个动作之前时使用

examples.en: Last year a journalist had been instructed by a well-known magazine to write an article.
examples.zh: 去年，一位记者受一家知名杂志委托写一篇文章。

examples.en: All the tickets had been sold out when we arrived at the cinema.
examples.zh: 我们到电影院的时候，所有票都已经卖光了。

grammar.title: not only位于句首的部分倒装结构
grammar.definition: 当not only放在句首连接两个分句时，第一个分句需要进行部分倒装，将助动词/情态动词/be动词提到主语之前，第二个分句保持正常语序
grammar.structure: Not only + 助动词/情态动词/be动词 + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他, but + 正常语序的分句
grammar.usage: 用于加强语气，突出“不仅……而且……”的递进关系

examples.en: Not only had the poor man been arrested, but he had been sent to prison as well.
examples.zh: 这个可怜的人不仅被逮捕了，还被送进了监狱。

examples.en: Not only does he speak English fluently, but he also knows French.
examples.zh: 他不仅英语说得流利，还懂法语。

patterns.pattern: sb be instructed to do sth

original.en: Last year a journalist had been instructed by a well-known magazine to write an article on the president's palace.
original.zh: 去年，一位记者受一家知名杂志委托，写一篇关于某个非洲新共和国总统府的文章。

examples.en: The new intern was instructed by the manager to collect customer feedback.
examples.zh: 新来的实习生被经理要求收集客户反馈。

examples.en: All the team members were instructed to arrive at the office before 8 a.m. tomorrow.
examples.zh: 所有团队成员都被要求明天早上8点前到达办公室。

patterns.pattern: sb sent sb sth informing sb that...

original.en: He sent yet another fax informing the journalist that if he did not reply soon he would be fired.
original.zh: 他又发了一份传真，通知记者如果他再不尽快回复就会被解雇。

examples.en: The teacher sent all parents a message informing them that the parent-teacher meeting would be held next Friday.
examples.zh: 老师给所有家长发了一条消息，通知他们下周五将召开家长会。

examples.en: The travel agency sent us an email informing us that our flight had been delayed for two hours.
examples.zh: 旅行社给我们发了一封邮件，通知我们的航班延误了两个小时。
